name: Table
description: A semantic HTML table component with sub-components for all table sections. Supports striped rows, bordered cells, and two size presets. Caption is required for accessibility.

notes: The caption prop is required and renders a <caption> element for screen reader context.
Th requires a scope attribute ('col' or 'row') to identify header cells correctly.
Use Thead, Tbody, and Tfoot for proper semantic grouping.
Avoid using the Table for layout — it is strictly for tabular data.

caption.description: REQUIRED. Accessible caption for the table. Rendered as a <caption> element.

striped.description: When true, alternating body rows receive a subtle background.

bordered.description: When true, all cells have visible borders.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the <table> element.

subcomponents.Th: Renders <th> — a header cell. Requires scope='col' or scope='row'.

do: Always provide a caption that describes the table's purpose.
Use scope='col' on header cells in Thead and scope='row' on header cells in Tbody.
Use striped for long tables to aid row scanning.
Use size='sm' for dense data tables within compact layouts.
dont: Do not use Table for layout or non-tabular content.
Do not omit the caption prop.
Do not omit the scope attribute on Th elements.
